definition: I. צַלְמוֺן proper name, of a mountain 1. ׳ הַרצֿ Judg 9:48 near Shechem, not identified, compare GFM , Buhl Geogr. 100 ; Ερμων (erroneous). 2. snow-capped mountain Ps 68:14 , probably east of Jordan (in Hauran according to Wetzst , compare Buhl Geogr. 118 ), Σελμων .
